definitions.explanation: The act of switching, substituting, or rescheduling something. Used for bank transfers, substitute holidays, rerouted transportation, and rescheduled classes or events.

examples.japanese: {振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ}で{月曜日|げつようび}が{休|やす}みだ。
examples.english: Monday is a day off as a substitute holiday.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まったので、{振替|ふりかえ}{輸送|ゆそう}を{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: The train stopped due to an accident, so I used the rerouted service.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}で{毎月|まいつき}の{家賃|やちん}を{払|はら}っている。
examples.english: I pay the monthly rent by automatic bank transfer.

notes:
USAGE:
{振替|ふりかえ} appears in several important compound terms that learners will encounter regularly in daily life in Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- {振替|ふりかえ}{休日|きゅうじつ} (substitute holiday — when a national holiday falls on a Sunday, the following Monday becomes a holiday)
- {振替|ふりかえ}{輸送|ゆそう} (rerouted transportation — when trains stop, passengers are directed to alternative lines)
- {口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ} (automatic bank transfer, direct debit)
- {振替|ふりかえ}{授業|じゅぎょう} (make-up class)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{振|ふ}り{込|こ}み refers to a bank wire transfer (actively sending money), while {口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ} is an automatic deduction from one's account.
